metadata.description: Builds one image-generation prompt per photo for a minimalist hand-drawn paper-cover illustration on a 3:4 canvas: the photo's most recognisable subject reduced to imperfect lines and at most 4 flat colours, small and centred on rough paper with generous negative space and optional editorial typography.

plugins.name: paper-illustration
plugins.description: Use when the user wants a photo reinterpreted as a minimal hand-drawn paper illustration, with no photograph in the frame.
